text:
An orderly morning at the desk began with your report, and we are sorry that your companion animal travel experience with Aurelia Skyways did not meet the care and clarity you expected. You explained that the handling of your pet, the guidance you received, and the handoff between services left you feeling uneasy and unsupported.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. The Companion Animal Travel Desk takes every report seriously, especially when a traveler feels that a pet may not have been treated with the calm attention we aim to provide. We understand how unsettling it is when a journey does not feel smooth from the first check-in moment through boarding, and we regret that our service fell short for you.

Our ground team is expected to move carriers carefully between services, and the welcome team is expected to prepare passengers with practical, reassuring instructions before boarding. We also share concise guidance with crews so that each step remains consistent and easy to follow. When any part of that process breaks down, it can create confusion for the traveler and stress for the animal, and that is not the standard we want to uphold.

We are reviewing your complaint with the staff involved so we can understand where the communication or handling slipped. We will use your report to reinforce the expectations already in place for calm handling, clear explanation, and timely support. If there was a missed instruction, a delay in response, or a concern about the way your pet was carried or prepared, we will address it directly through our internal review.

Please accept our apology for the distress this caused. We value the trust you place in Aurelia Skyways, and we want future travel to feel more settled and dependable. If you choose to travel with us again, the Companion Animal Travel Desk will continue to provide practical guidance and close attention to your companion animal's needs throughout the journey.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
